title: WebMapX Layer Repository — Harvest Source
description: A curated pointer to somewhere layers can be read from automatically. This is the hand-maintained part of the catalog: reviewing one means judging whether an endpoint is worth trusting, which a person can do — as opposed to eyeballing the thousands of layer records it yields, which nobody can. Everything downstream is generated into harvested/ and is not in git.

type.description: How to read this source. Self-describing services (WMS/WMTS GetCapabilities, OGC API) versus third-party catalogues that already did the harvesting, of which the QGIS PDOK plugin's layer list is one.

url.description: Where to read it. A capabilities document, or the catalogue file itself.

provider.description: Who the harvested layers belong to. Read off the source rather than inferred from its hostname, because a catalogue or cache is not the provider of what it lists.

region.description: Path under layers/ the output belongs to, e.g. world/europe/netherlands

maintainer.description: Who keeps the source itself current. That a list is maintained by a known person is a fact about the source, not about each layer in it.

include.description: Which of the source's layers to take. A capabilities document usually offers far more than is worth publishing.

serviceTypes.description: Default: those a web map can render (wms, wmts, api tiles)

crs.description: Drop layers the service cannot deliver in this CRS

match.description: Regular expression the layer name or title must match

exclude.description: Regular expression that disqualifies a layer

limit.description: Cap on layers taken, for a first pass at a very large source
